# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| latest  | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it by emailing security@kubedoll.com.

Please include:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Suggested fix (if any)

We will respond within 48 hours and work with you to understand and address the issue.

## Security Measures

This fork maintains the following security practices:
- Dependabot for automated dependency updates
- Gitleaks for secret detection in pre-commit hooks
- GitHub Actions workflow validation
